note: Two related entities appear in customs data at the same address (39/940-A, Karakkat Road, Kerala): 'MARINE EQUIPMENTS CENTRE' (117 records, latest 2025-02-24) and 'MARINE EQUIPMENTS CENTRE PRIVATE LIMITED' (146 records, latest 2026-02-06). Both are aircraft-parts traders: the flow is largely import of aircraft parts/components (from Magellan Aviation Group 131, Defence Aero 25/6, LAS Aerospace 36, Aerotechnic Asia 120, CVC Components 14) and re-supply to Russian carriers (Rossiya Airlines, Aeroflot Technics, M-Service) plus UAE free-zone traders (Prime Edge FZCO, Zora Electronics Trading FZE, Tech Way Trading FZE). Role: trader (aircraft parts), not manufacturer — declared HS codes 681381/760612/840710/841112 do not match the observed codes (83021090, 84111200, 73261990, 90328990, 85365090, 85437099, 49019900); per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, actual codes should be recorded. Export shipments are confirmed by dated customs rows with BOL numbers and destinations, so the export side is factual, not merely declared. Domestic Indian supply evidence was not found in the sources read (null). Note the Russia-facing trade pattern — neutral observation only, not a rejection ground. Volza and Eximpedia free views returned HTTP 403, so ImportKey was the only readable shipment source; the 146/117 counters are the site's own totals and only 5 rows each were actually visible.
